note: READ-ONLY staging checks for the Say Hello greeting feature (gateway side). The suggestion route is only probed unauthenticated; no greeting is generated or sent on staging. The Send path and guard are proven by the jest suites below.

tests.name: gateway answers on the deployed build
greeting-suggestion route is mounted and requires auth (JSON, not an SPA HTML fallback)
tests.reason: A mounted API route rejects the unauthenticated caller with a JSON 401; an HTML body (200 text/html) would mean the route is missing and the SPA index was served instead. The probe sends no credentials and only READS the route's auth behaviour — it never generates or sends a greeting.

Write-path proof of the greeting guard (403 refusals, fail-closed, untagged DM unchanged) and the suggestion route (suggest-only, 503 on failure) over an in-memory DB; nothing is written to a live system.
